# gtk4's pictures under --simulate, with no GTK: a source's picture is an
# owned derived value of the source, made once per URL and released when the
# URL changes or the source unmounts -- in an image, in a drawing, and in a
# drawing's copies under a `for` -- so a test that rekeys every source and
# tears the application down is left holding nothing.

env PATH=

sngl test --simulate gtk4 app.sngl
stdout '^ok   2 tests, 0 failures$'
! stdout 'leak'

-- app.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import draw "sngl:ui/draw"
import "sngl:test"

component page ui.node {
    var src = "a.png"
    var more = ["b.png", "c.png"]

    ui.vbox {
        ui.image {
            ui.file(src)
        }
        draw.canvas(width=200px, height=100px) {
            draw.canvasImage(x=0.0, y=0.0, w=100.0, h=100.0) {
                ui.file(src)
            }
            for var p = more {
                draw.canvasImage(x=100.0, y=0.0, w=50.0, h=50.0) {
                    ui.remote(p)
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

func testRekeys(t test.Test, c page) {
    c.src = "d.png"
    c.more = ["e.png"]
}

func testHolds(t test.Test, c page) {
    t.assert(c.src == "a.png")
}

ui.window(title="t") {
    page
}
